The '''Pako Ramoon system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Rayter sector/Legends|Rayter sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It contained the world of [[Pako Ramoon]].
